heading: INT. GRAND BALLROOM - STEAMSHIP "MERIDIAN QUEEN" - NIGHT

units.text: INT. GRAND BALLROOM - STEAMSHIP "MERIDIAN QUEEN" - NIGHT
A glittering room of mirrors and chandeliers.
A string quartet plays a waltz.
Couples whirl across a parquet floor, gowns blooming like opened flowers.
Waiters weave among them with trays of champagne.
At the edge of the floor, ELEANOR "NELL" VASCONCELOS-HART (20s, emerald gown, gloved hands clasped) stands beside a potted palm and watches the dancers.
She holds an untouched glass.
Across the room, CAPTAIN JULIAN ABERCROMBIE-SATO (30s, white dress uniform, polished buttons) stands alone beside the bandstand.
He is looking at her.
When she glances up, he glances away.
Her chaperone, AUNT BEATRICE (60s, lorgnette, plum silk), taps her fan against Nell's arm.
Stand up straight, child.
units.name: BEATRICE

units.text: Nell straightens.
Her eyes slide back to the captain.
That man has been staring for twenty minutes.
units.name: BEATRICE

units.text: I hadn't noticed.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Then you are the only one.
units.name: BEATRICE

units.text: A waiter offers a tray.
Nell takes a fresh glass and trades it for the old.
Her fingers tremble.
The quartet shifts into a new waltz.
Julian crosses the floor.
Couples part for him.
He stops before Nell and bows.
Miss Vasconcelos-Hart.
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: Captain.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Would you honor me with this dance?
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: Beatrice's fan snaps open.
Nell glances at her.
The fan lowers by an inch.
Nell sets her glass on the waiter's tray and takes his hand.
They step onto the floor.
He places a hand at her waist.
She rests hers on his shoulder.
They begin to turn, stiff at first, then easier.
You do not dance often.
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: I do not dance at all.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Then I am honored.
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: The music swells.
Her gloved fingers tighten on his sleeve.
He leads her through the crowd, and the room blurs gold around them.
A loud crash cuts through the music.
A tray of glasses has hit the floor.
Dancers stumble and stop.
At the entrance stands LORD PERCIVAL HOLLOWAY (40s, tailcoat, red carnation), flushed and unsteady, one hand clutching a champagne bottle by the neck.
He stares across the ballroom at Nell.
Eleanor!
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: The quartet falters.
Beatrice gasps.
Nell and Julian freeze mid-turn.
Julian steps in front of her.
Percival strides forward, shoving through the crowd.
A waiter dodges.
A matron shrieks.
Two stewards rush to intercept, and Percival swings the bottle, and the stewards jump back.
Lord Holloway, you are drunk.
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: And you are in my way.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: Julian does not move.
Nell steps beside him, then past him.
She faces Percival directly, her chin raised.
Percival. Put that down.
units.name: NELL

units.text: He stares at her.
The bottle trembles in his grasp.
Slowly, he lowers it.
You promised.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: I promised nothing.
units.name: NELL

units.text: His face crumples.
The bottle slips from his fingers and shatters on the parquet.
Champagne foams across the floor.
The quartet has stopped.
The entire ballroom holds its breath.
Beatrice sweeps forward and takes Percival firmly by the elbow.
He allows himself to be led.
The crowd parts for them.
A moment of silence.
Then the first violin lifts his bow, and the waltz resumes, hesitant, uncertain.
Julian turns to Nell.
She is trembling.
He holds out his hand.
Shall we finish?
units.name: JULIAN

units.text: She looks at his hand.
She looks at the shattered glass.
She looks at the doors where Beatrice and Percival have vanished.
Then she places her hand in his, and the two of them step back into the dance.
